shorts.topic: Why is it called a honeymoon?
shorts.title: The weird dark origin of honeymoons
shorts.description: Why do newlyweds get a honeymoon? Blame ancient Babylon and a lot of alcohol. #shorts #history #funfacts #marriage
shorts.pinned: Would you survive 30 straight days of mead?
shorts.cover: Shot 8 - drawing of a groom chugging mead under a giant moon

shots.say: Honeymoons used to be weird.
Babylon weird, roughly four thousand years ago.
The bride's dad supplied all the booze.
Specifically mead, which is fermented honey.
The groom was forced to drink it.
Every single day for one lunar month.
The official goal was boosting male fertility.
Because apparently, thirty consecutive blackouts
is peak romantic performance.
If a baby arrived nine months later,
the brewer actually got a cash bonus.
Then sixteenth century poets ruined the vibe.
So when you book that vacation,
remember you escaped mandatory ancient drunkenness.
Unless that was the goal, since

shorts.title: The terrifying origin of the Best Man
shorts.description: Your best man used to carry a sword to kidnap people. Weddings were intense. #shorts #history #wedding #facts
shorts.pinned: Who would you trust with a sword at your wedding?
shorts.cover: Shot 11 - stick figure holding a giant sword next to an altar

shots.text: THE BEST MAN WAS A HITMAN.
shots.say: The best man was a hitman.
Modern weddings give him mild duties.
Maybe plan a mediocre weekend in Vegas.
Back then, weddings were competitive sports.
If a village ran out of brides,
Naturally, her angry family chased you.
So the groom brought his best fighter.
Literally the best man with a sword.
If the bride tried running away,
he physically kept her at the ceremony.
He stood right beside the groom
with his right hand near his blade.
